## Summary

Total employment in the region rose by 4,300 jobs over the quarter, an
increase of 0.4%. The unemployment rate was unchanged at 4.1%.

## Industry detail

Health care and social assistance accounted for most of the quarterly gain.
Manufacturing employment fell for a third consecutive quarter.

## Notes

Estimates are seasonally adjusted and rounded to the nearest hundred.
